raw_text_en: The platform ingests enterprise documents and user-submitted cases, searches permitted knowledge, drafts grounded responses, applies deterministic risk policy, routes uncertain/sensitive recommendations to authorized reviewers, publishes through a satisfied gate, and preserves auditable evidence. Classification, retrieval, generation, policy evaluation, approval and publication are distinct activities; separate records do not require separate screens. [Source: pp.7,11–12, §§2.1–2.2; `screen_functions:r1:c4:f1`, `screen_functions:r1:c11:f1`, `screen_functions:r1:c13:f4`]

raw_text_en: Every request binds an authenticated principal and tenant. Authorization combines role, tenant, workspace membership, case sensitivity, source ACL, action and separation of duties. Apply checks at edge, domain transaction, retrieval, tool dispatch and publication as applicable; hiding or disabling navigation is not authorization. Originating ACL filtering precedes text release to generation. Cross-tenant resource substitution returns the absent-resource not-found response class without disclosing private existence. [Source: pp.21–23 §§5.1–5.3,34 chapter9,89 TST-003; `screen_functions:r1:c29:f1`, `screen_functions:r1:c31:f4`, `screen_functions:r1:c32:f4`, `screen_functions:r1:c53:f2`, `screen_functions:r1:c141:f3`]

raw_text_en: Interactive authentication uses authorization-code flow with PKCE. Access tokens contain issuer, audience, expiry, subject and tenant; unexpected algorithms and missing tenancy claims are rejected. Do not store long-lived refresh tokens in browser local storage. Secure `HttpOnly`, `SameSite` BFF cookies are an optional source-supported alternative, not a selected architecture. Login/logout routes, session durations, refresh and expiry displays are **Needs confirmation**. [Source: p.21 §5.1; `screen_functions:r1:c30:f1`, `screen_functions:r1:c30:f5`]

raw_text_en: For each field below, **all attributes not explicitly stated are Needs confirmation**: UI type, length, format, requiredness, initial value, editability, input constraints, validation timing, conditional visibility and selectable-value/data source. Domain persistence types, API types and mockup formatting are labeled separately and must not be copied into UI contracts indiscriminately. No arbitrary field defaults, numeric limits, error copy or recovery flow is authorized by an omission.

context_en: 1. Screen Function Specification > Functions by Screen > SF-006 — Shared field-definition and interaction rules
1. Screen Function Specification > Functions by Screen > SF-006 — Shared field-definition and interaction rules
raw_text_en: Server validation occurs before transaction entry, again at domain invariants, and before tool dispatch. Endpoint-specific validation precedes allocation of long-running work. Client validation is convenience only. On unavailable dependencies, generic source contracts allow a documented retryable error **or** persisted asynchronous job identifier, never ambiguous success; selection conditions and shapes are open. GET wording does not establish universal job creation. [Source: pp.54–56 §§15.1–15.3; `screen_functions:r1:c92:f4`, `screen_functions:r1:c90:f3`, `screen_functions:r1:c90:f7`]

raw_text_en: Each actual durable-state-changing boundary record carries `tenant_id`, `revision`, `actor_id`, `occurred_at` and a correlation ID under the source's condition “wherever the operation changes durable state.” General tenant/actor boundary context remains required. These are not editable browser fields. Canonical event fields are separately `event_id`, `type`, `schema_version`, `tenant_id`, `aggregate_id`, `aggregate_revision`, `occurred_at`, `trace_id`, `payload`, using UTC/canonical JSON; aliases between the lists are not supplied. [Source: p.48 §13.1 and pp.57–59; `screen_functions:r1:c78:f1`, `screen_functions:r1:c96:f2`, `screen_functions:r1:c97:f4`, `screen_functions:r1:c98:f7`]

raw_text_en: Planner DAG depth is **8**, maximum tool invocations **16**, explicit dependencies/replayable checkpoints, with stored plan revision before side effects. Triage, Research and Draft are bounded AI responsibilities; Policy Evaluator is deterministic. Browser-supplied arbitrary tool definitions are prohibited. Discovery and model text never confer action authority. Pinned approved MCP schemas validate arguments; external writes need separate capability permission; mutable operations need idempotency and, when consequential, human authorization. A denied action cannot be replaced by a semantically equivalent tool. [Source: pp.7,40–42; `screen_functions:r1:c4:f2`, `screen_functions:r1:c4:f4`, `screen_functions:r1:c66:f1`, `screen_functions:r1:c66:f4`, `screen_functions:r1:c67:f1`, `screen_functions:r1:c67:f4`, `screen_functions:r1:c68:f4`]

raw_text_en: All revised invariants link to a negative test. Minimum release pack includes unit, schema evolution, negative authorization, replay, staging sync, visual accessibility, search recall, grounding, policy recall, load and disaster recovery. Randomized tests record seeds; synthetic corpora are frozen/versioned/independently reviewed for leakage; outputs are signed/release-digest linked. 2. API Specification > API Inventory and Responsibilities > API-001 — Scope, authority and traceability
raw_text_en: The API scope includes enterprise document ingestion, permission-aware retrieval, grounded drafting, deterministic policy, human review, publication, audit and controlled operations. Physical automation, irreversible financial transactions, foundation-model fine-tuning, unrestricted browsing and agent cloud-administration permissions are **Out of scope**. Application-hosted GPU inference is excluded. Cross-region active/active mutation, OCR beyond English and customer-managed model weights are deferred. [Source: pp.7,9–10,19; `api:r1:c4:f1`, `api:r1:c7:f1`, `api:r1:c8:f5`, `api:r1:c25:f2`]

context_en: 2. API Specification > API Inventory and Responsibilities > API-002 — Shared authentication and authorization
2. API Specification > API Inventory and Responsibilities > API-002 — Shared authentication and authorization
raw_text_en: Every request binds an authenticated principal and tenant. Authorization combines role, tenant, workspace membership, resource attributes, case sensitivity, originating document ACL, action and separation of duties. Apply it at edge, domain transaction, retrieval, tool dispatch and publication as applicable. Navigation hiding is not authorization. Baseline roles are `Analyst`, `Reviewer`, `Admin`, `Auditor`, `Service`; Appendix A's `Owner`, `Member` and `approver` scopes require mapping. `Workspace Admin` is not silently equated with `Admin`. [Source: pp.11,21–23,41,83; `api:r1:c12:f1`, `api:r1:c29:f1`, `api:r1:c31:f1`, `api:r1:c31:f5`, `api:r1:c67:f1`, `api:r1:c137:f8`, `api:r1:c137:f15`]

raw_text_en: 1. Validate request payload **before transaction entry**, then domain invariants, then tool dispatch; validate before allocating long-running work. Browser validation is convenience, not security.

context_en: 2. API Specification > Processing and Consistency > API-048 — Validation, transactions, tenancy and retry safety
raw_text_en: 2. Set authenticated tenant/resource context for each domain transaction; re-evaluate attributes inside the transaction and apply RLS.

context_en: 2. API Specification > Processing and Consistency > API-048 — Validation, transactions, tenancy and retry safety
raw_text_en: 3. Reject stale/unauthorized writes before relevant business event publication; leave business state unchanged. Denial audits and duplicate ledger outcomes are not accepted business mutations.

context_en: 2. API Specification > Processing and Consistency > API-048 — Validation, transactions, tenancy and retry safety
raw_text_en: 4. Commit the stated case mutation/approval decision/outbox ACID boundary as applicable. The source does not establish that every case mutation simultaneously approves another record. Search indexing/webhooks are asynchronous with reconciliation.

context_en: 2. API Specification > Processing and Consistency > API-048 — Validation, transactions, tenancy and retry safety
raw_text_en: 5. Accepted state transitions require **one audit record**, tenant-scoped traces and stable denial codes. Events are observable through correlated logs/audit without document text in diagnostic telemetry.

context_en: 2. API Specification > Processing and Consistency > API-048 — Validation, transactions, tenancy and retry safety
raw_text_en: 6. Every cross-service write is retry-safe. At-least-once consumers check event identity/operation key, ledger and aggregate revision, record duplicate outcome and do not reapply mutation. Detect stale/delayed revisions without relying on cross-partition ordering.

context_en: 2. API Specification > Processing and Consistency > API-048 — Validation, transactions, tenancy and retry safety
raw_text_en: 7. Transient faults use bounded exponential backoff, randomized jitter and per-dependency breakers; **validation/permission failures are permanent and never retried**.

raw_text_en: 1. Validate/authorize Analyst creation, apply idempotency and create `NEW` with `201`/case identifier.

raw_text_en: 2. Asynchronously classify, retaining labels/confidences/provenance; user corrections require a reason code, with correction endpoint/catalog open.

raw_text_en: **Retrieval:** ACL filtering precedes generation text release; relevance never grants access. Form lexical/normalized vector queries, bound candidates, RRF merge, deterministic rerank, diversify documents/sources and cap model-context tokens. Internal search rows retain tenant/workspace/version/chunk/language/classification, normalized text and **1536-dimensional embeddings**. Parallel rebuilds atomically switch read alias only after completeness/recall checks; database remains authoritative. Cache keys include tenant, user-scope digest, source ACL revision, query hash and index generation. Permission change purges affected cache before TTL and next-query access remains mandatory. raw_text_en: Export/delete both require **two independent approval checks**; export explicitly requires **two-person approval plus manifest**, and a single Admin fails. Export includes case metadata, approved artifacts, source references and checksum audit manifests; exclude secrets/internal prompts. Deletion applies holds/tombstones/blob/index removal/completion receipts. Held protected records are retained and receipted. Data-subject requests use the same inventory, not a newly invented endpoint. Manifest/receipt/checksum/approval/download/status and partial-failure schemas remain open. Diagnostic TTL **30-day default**, audit **seven-year fictional policy**, receipts/holds apply; corporate retention remains unselected. raw_text_en: Governance records changes/impact scores and minor/major revision effects; revised invariants require negative tests. Release tooling uses reproducible artifacts, source nonsecret defaults, signed environment values, vault references, scans/tests/SBOM/signed images and allowed build identity. Terraform/Bicep remains alternative. Compatible migrations precede canary; old replicas drain before enforcement; rollback plans disclose new-write readability. Regression triggers traffic rollback, **not database down-migration**. Security/SRE verify egress/secrets/backups/alerts before promotion. Release records bind image/schema/prompt/model-routing policy, and versions must be reconstructible. Gate thresholds/signatures/interfaces remain open. raw_text_en: The data scope includes enterprise knowledge/cases, grounded evidence, deterministic policy, review/publication, audit and operational evidence. API-005 PATCH uses `If-Match` (`200/409`). Actor/request-fingerprint outcomes are retained for24 hours; identical same-key creation yields one case/identical response, changed-body reuse yields `409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`. Conflict returns `CASE_VERSION_CONFLICT` and current revision without changing business state. Long-running-job POST mutations transport `Idempotency-Key`; its complete scope/fingerprint/expiry contract remains open. raw_text_en: Audit is append-only, batch-hash chained and exported to independently controlled retention storage. Operators query but never alter historical review decisions; Auditor scope is redacted/nonediting. Diagnostic logs have30-day **default** TTL; security audit follows a distinct7-year **fictional** policy. Corporate retention selection remains unresolved. Purges record receipts/legal-hold exceptions; do not apply diagnostic TTL to security audit. Retention jobs consider only eligible closed cases; CLOSED alone is not eligibility. context_en: 3. Data Specification > Lifecycle and Consistency > DAT-016 — Audit, retention and controlled exit
3. Data Specification > Lifecycle and Consistency > DAT-016 — Audit, retention and controlled exit
raw_text_en: Export/delete both require two independent approval checks and `Admin + approver` scope. Export explicitly requires **two-person approval plus manifest**; single Admin fails. Export contains case metadata, approved artifacts, source references and checksum audit manifests, excluding secrets/internal prompts. Deletion honors holds, writes tombstones, removes blobs/index entries and records receipts; held protected records are retained/receipted. Soft-deleted entities cannot be retrieved; final purge is scheduled tombstone processing. API-016/017 `202` is acceptance, not completion. Data-subject access uses the same inventory, not an invented endpoint. Tenant/workspace scope, partial receipts and lineage purge remain open. DAT-015 vault/rotation rules remain binding during retention/exit. raw_text_en: ### BAT-001–003 — Classification, synchronization and backfill

context_en: 4. Batch Function Specification > Processing by Job > BAT-001–003 — Classification, synchronization and backfill
4. Batch Function Specification > Processing by Job > BAT-001–003 — Classification, synchronization and backfill
raw_text_en: 1. **BAT-001:** consume CaseCreated case ID/revision in tenant scope; process NEW intake/business context and attach policy-aware labels, confidences and provenance. User correction requires reason code. Label domains, algorithm, attachment-completeness predicate, authorized correction interface and classification completion state remain BAT-OQ-006. Do not merge this event with RunRequested or assume run launch emits CaseCreated. [pp.12,87; `batch_functions:r1:c13:f1`, `batch_functions:r1:c139:f1`]

context_en: 4. Batch Function Specification > Processing by Job > BAT-001–003 — Classification, synchronization and backfill
raw_text_en: 2. **BAT-002:** require complete provisioning and configured provider; inspect advertised list/fetch/delta cursor/ACL/delete support. Unsupported capabilities produce an explicit visible lower-trust warning, never silent assumptions or ACL bypass. Resolve workspace vault references; revoked queued credentials fail `CONNECTOR_REAUTH_REQUIRED` without token disclosure. Already-running revocation behavior remains open. [pp.27–28,78; `batch_functions:r1:c42:f1`, `batch_functions:r1:c42:f5`, `batch_functions:r1:c132:f2`]

context_en: 4. Batch Function Specification > Processing by Job > BAT-001–003 — Classification, synchronization and backfill
raw_text_en: 3. Persist provider cursor/high-watermark/error ledger. Advance only after durable preceding ingestion outcomes. Partial batches retry safely. After bounded retries quarantine malformed items with reason/correlation/remediation; **remaining batch may proceed while ledger records the exception**. Continuation is permitted, not mandatory; quarantined item is not declared successful. Exact outcome/advancement predicate remains open. [pp.28–29; `batch_functions:r1:c43:f1`, `batch_functions:r1:c44:f6`]

context_en: 4. Batch Function Specification > Processing by Job > BAT-001–003 — Classification, synchronization and backfill
raw_text_en: 4. Honor `Retry-After`, exponential backoff/jitter, workspace quotas and fair scheduling so a large tenant cannot starve smaller workspaces. No quota/batch/retry number is selected. [p.28; `batch_functions:r1:c44:f1`]

context_en: 4. Batch Function Specification > Processing by Job > BAT-001–003 — Classification, synchronization and backfill
raw_text_en: 5. Source deletion creates tombstone/scheduled index removal. ACL changes invalidate affected cache before serving new results; revoked access applies before next retrieval even during cleanup. [pp.27–29; `batch_functions:r1:c41:f2`, `batch_functions:r1:c43:f4`, `batch_functions:r1:c43:f5`]

context_en: 4. Batch Function Specification > Processing by Job > BAT-001–003 — Classification, synchronization and backfill
raw_text_en: 6. **BAT-003:** ingest historic sources in bounded windows using stable source IDs and per-batch reconciliation receipts. Determine search readiness from indexed coverage, **not merely queue emptiness**. Receipt schema, window bounds, coverage threshold, no-input and whole-run completion remain BAT-OQ-006. [p.78; `batch_functions:r1:c132:f7`, `batch_functions:r1:c132:f8`]

raw_text_en: ### BAT-004–006 — Ingestion, index promotion and reconciliation

context_en: 4. Batch Function Specification > Processing by Job > BAT-004–006 — Ingestion, index promotion and reconciliation
4. Batch Function Specification > Processing by Job > BAT-004–006 — Ingestion, index promotion and reconciliation
raw_text_en: 1. Admit only R1PDF/DOCX/HTML/UTF-8 text with MIME signature/extension agreement, configurable **25MB per file**, and decompression-bomb protection. MIME literals, MB convention and bomb/sandbox thresholds remain open. ZIP appears only as a hostile test fixture, not an admitted format.

context_en: 4. Batch Function Specification > Processing by Job > BAT-004–006 — Ingestion, index promotion and reconciliation
raw_text_en: 2. Scan before parse. Disable macros; do not fetch embedded remote references. Unsafe attachments quarantine and never enter search.

context_en: 4. Batch Function Specification > Processing by Job > BAT-004–006 — Ingestion, index promotion and reconciliation
raw_text_en: 3. Preserve PDF block page index/bbox, table rows/columns, heading/reading order for chunking. OCR is opt-in and provenance-marked; beyond-English OCR deferred.

context_en: 4. Batch Function Specification > Processing by Job > BAT-004–006 — Ingestion, index promotion and reconciliation
raw_text_en: 4. Normalize transport artifacts without rewriting source claims. Content fingerprint plus pipeline version identifies immutable derivatives; revised processing may coexist side by side rather than overwrite history.

context_en: 4. Batch Function Specification > Processing by Job > BAT-004–006 — Ingestion, index promotion and reconciliation
raw_text_en: 5. Store chunk URI/file hash/page/**optional** bbox. PDF block mandatory bbox does not make chunk bbox mandatory. Quality indicators include empty-page ratio, unknown-character ratio, table loss and language confidence. Low-quality authorized documents remain viewable but excluded from autonomous recommendations; low quality is not automatically unsafe quarantine. Thresholds/indexability/status mapping remain BAT-OQ-007.

context_en: 4. Batch Function Specification > Processing by Job > BAT-004–006 — Ingestion, index promotion and reconciliation
raw_text_en: 6. `DocumentNormalized`, Ingestion version ID/source hash, builds index. Search rows contain tenant/workspace/document-version/chunk/language/classification, normalized keyword text and **1536-dimensional** embedding.

context_en: 4. Batch Function Specification > Processing by Job > BAT-004–006 — Ingestion, index promotion and reconciliation
raw_text_en: 7. Rebuild a parallel index; switch versioned read alias atomically only after completeness and recall checks. Database remains authoritative. `SearchIndexCommitted`, Indexer generation/document revision, invalidates query cache. Promotion arbitration, thresholds and retired-generation policy remain open.

context_en: 4. Batch Function Specification > Processing by Job > BAT-004–006 — Ingestion, index promotion and reconciliation
raw_text_en: 8. Failed index write **does not roll back accepted source metadata**. BAT-006 compares fingerprints/retries and repairs broken links from outbox. Apply permanent-error nonretry; no unrestricted repair loop is authorized. Reconciliation successful completion/receipt and selection remain open.

raw_text_en: 1. Create accepted run immediately; persist DAG plan revision before side effects. Depth **8**, maximum **16** tool invocations, explicit dependencies/replayable checkpoints. Persist each stage checkpoint before downstream dispatch.

context_en: 4. Batch Function Specification > Processing by Job > BAT-007–009 — Grounded workflow, review expiry and publication
raw_text_en: 2. Retrieve only current permitted evidence before releasing text to generation. Form lexical/normalized vector queries, bounded candidates, reciprocal rank fusion, deterministic rerank, document/source diversity and per-query token budget. Ranking never authorizes. Evidence includes chunk ID/source title/document revision/page anchor/ACL digest; citation identifiers are opaque/verified.

context_en: 4. Batch Function Specification > Processing by Job > BAT-007–009 — Grounded workflow, review expiry and publication
raw_text_en: 3. If confidence **OR** quality insufficient, return `NO_SUPPORTED_EVIDENCE`, never fabricated context. Clarification **OR** human routing remains unselected; missing citations produce needs-review **OR** unsupported under TST-009, not a chosen universal state.

context_en: 4. Batch Function Specification > Processing by Job > BAT-007–009 — Grounded workflow, review expiry and publication
raw_text_en: 4. Whitelist approved deployments by capability/region/handling/context/cost/evaluation. Reserve input/output tokens and track provider usage under workspace quota. Exhaustion is terminal for current run without automatic model/data-class change. Approved fallback requires equal-or-stronger handling and approved region/deployment; no restricted content in unapproved region on outage.

context_en: 4. Batch Function Specification > Processing by Job > BAT-007–009 — Grounded workflow, review expiry and publication
raw_text_en: 5. Compose fixed rules, signed workflow instruction, validated user input and delimited untrusted passages; strip evidence tool directives and record injection indicators. Model text never authorizes. Versioned JSON parsing has bounded retries; unknown fields, invalid citations/control injection produce `MODEL_OUTPUT_INVALID` and no publication.

context_en: 4. Batch Function Specification > Processing by Job > BAT-007–009 — Grounded workflow, review expiry and publication
raw_text_en: 6. Dispatch only pinned approved MCP schemas/validated arguments/scoped service credentials. External writes need separate capability, mutable calls idempotency and consequential human authorization. Discovery/A2A registration grants no permission; receivers may decline; denied actions cannot be replaced by equivalent tools.

context_en: 4. Batch Function Specification > Processing by Job > BAT-007–009 — Grounded workflow, review expiry and publication
raw_text_en: 7. Normalize/store policy sensitivity/action/evidence quality/model class/financial impact/confidence with rule version. Deterministic outcomes: `AUTO_ALLOW`, `HUMAN_REVIEW`, `REQUEST_MORE_EVIDENCE`, `DENY`; model tags cannot override. High-impact becomes review task, not autonomous mutation.

context_en: 4. Batch Function Specification > Processing by Job > BAT-007–009 — Grounded workflow, review expiry and publication
raw_text_en: 8. Select policy reviewer pool/minimum role/separation. Display exact candidate/citations/model-prompt version/policy reasons and inspectable anchored source. Required review fields gate Approve/Reject UI, not authorization. Record decision/actor/time/hash/rationale and optional annotations; changed/wrong-hash decisions stale-reject/audit with unchanged business state.

context_en: 4. Batch Function Specification > Processing by Job > BAT-007–009 — Grounded workflow, review expiry and publication
raw_text_en: 9. On configured-SLA expiry reassign **OR** escalate without approval. TST-010 requires escalation recorded. SLA/time basis/branch/recipients and no-expired-task result remain open. Overrides require elevated role/secondary reviewer/audited reason; denied rework is new run revision, never retroactive approval.

context_en: 4. Batch Function Specification > Processing by Job > BAT-007–009 — Grounded workflow, review expiry and publication
raw_text_en: 10. ApprovalDecisionRecorded **validates** publication. Recompute current authorization after permission changes and reject stale evidence. Required evidence/satisfied versioned policy/exact hash apply; unapproved high-risk cannot publish. Commit final response pointer and satisfied gate in the **same transaction**; replay cannot publish changed content under old approval.

raw_text_en: Retrieval uses scoped tenant/workspace/version/chunk/language/classification rows, normalized text and **1536-dimensional embeddings**. Form lexical and normalized vector queries; bounded candidate retrieval → reciprocal rank fusion → deterministic reranking → redundancy/source-diversity control, subject to model-token cap and ACL filtering. No RRF equation, constant, scoring tie rule or selected numeric candidate/token limit is supplied by this operative prose. Cache identity includes tenant, user-scope digest, ACL revision, query hash and index generation; authorization change purges before normal TTL and must satisfy the stronger next-retrieval rule. [PDF pp.34–36,53; `business_rules:r1:c54:f1`, `business_rules:r1:c55:f1`, `business_rules:r1:c55:f6`, `business_rules:r1:c86:f7`, `business_rules:r1:c86:f8`]

raw_text_en: Every evidence item includes chunk ID, source title, document revision, page anchor and ACL digest; opaque citation identifiers are verified before display. Insufficient confidence **OR** quality returns `NO_SUPPORTED_EVIDENCE`, never fabricated context. Clarification **OR** human routing is permitted but unselected. Missing citations separately require needs-review **OR** unsupported outcome; do not silently choose a durable state. raw_text_en: 6. Persist DAG plan revision before side effects; depth **8**, maximum **16** tool invocations, explicit dependencies and replayable checkpoints. Each workflow stage checkpoints before downstream dispatch.

raw_text_en: 7. Dispatch approved pinned MCP schema/validated arguments with scoped credentials. A denied action cannot be replaced by an equivalent tool.

raw_text_en: 1. Bind authenticated principal and tenant. Apply role, workspace membership, sensitivity, originating ACL, action and separation at applicable edge, transaction, retrieval, tool and publication boundaries. Navigation hiding is not authorization.

context_en: 6. Exception Handling Specification > Handling by Exception > ERR-028 — Shared validation, authority and interruption rules
raw_text_en: 2. Validate before transaction entry, again at domain invariants, before tool dispatch and before long-work allocation. Client validation is convenience only.

context_en: 6. Exception Handling Specification > Handling by Exception > ERR-028 — Shared validation, authority and interruption rules
raw_text_en: 3. Reject stale/unauthorized business writes before their relevant event publication; leave business state unchanged. Denial audit and duplicate ledger evidence are not accepted business mutations.

context_en: 6. Exception Handling Specification > Handling by Exception > ERR-028 — Shared validation, authority and interruption rules
raw_text_en: 4. Preserve the stated local ACID mutation/decision/outbox boundary or explicitly reconciled saga. Do not create a global workflow transaction or assume every case mutation creates an approval decision.

context_en: 6. Exception Handling Specification > Handling by Exception > ERR-028 — Shared validation, authority and interruption rules
raw_text_en: 5. Never represent partial processing as an approved answer. Oversized uploads, injection, foreign IDs, stale decisions and ungrounded recommendations fail closed with stable non-sensitive codes.

context_en: 6. Exception Handling Specification > Handling by Exception > ERR-028 — Shared validation, authority and interruption rules
raw_text_en: 6. Degraded/recovered operation never bypasses authorization or approval.

raw_text_en: 1. **Unsupported evidence:** insufficient confidence **OR** quality returns `NO_SUPPORTED_EVIDENCE`, never fabricated context. Clarification **OR** human route is permitted but unselected. Missing citations separately yield needs review **OR** unsupported; do not silently choose a durable enum.

context_en: 6. Exception Handling Specification > Handling by Exception > ERR-012–016 — Grounding, model/tool failures and workflow stops
raw_text_en: 2. **Invalid structured model output:** bounded versioned-JSON parsing rejects unknown fields, invalid citations or control-character injection as `MODEL_OUTPUT_INVALID`; forced schema failure must not publish. Parsing counts and overlap with missing/unsupported citations remain open.

context_en: 6. Exception Handling Specification > Handling by Exception > ERR-012–016 — Grounding, model/tool failures and workflow stops
raw_text_en: 3. **Injection/authority:** delimit untrusted evidence, strip tool directives, record indicators, preserve provenance and allowlisted/pinned schemas. Model text and discovery never authorize. An indicator alone is not explicitly a universal run-stop predicate; an authority violation must fail closed.

context_en: 6. Exception Handling Specification > Handling by Exception > ERR-012–016 — Grounding, model/tool failures and workflow stops
raw_text_en: 4. **Tool dispatch:** validate approved MCP arguments with scoped identity; every external write needs separate capability; mutable calls require idempotency and consequential human authorization. Arbitrary invocation is `DENY` **before dispatch**. No semantically equivalent denied-tool workaround.

context_en: 6. Exception Handling Specification > Handling by Exception > ERR-012–016 — Grounding, model/tool failures and workflow stops

raw_text_en: 1. Export/delete require **two independent approval checks** and `Admin + approver`. Export specifically needs **two-person approval plus manifest**; a single Admin fails. Do not silently extend person semantics to every deletion check.

context_en: 6. Exception Handling Specification > Handling by Exception > ERR-024–027 — Exit, integrity, release and resilience
raw_text_en: 2. Export contains case metadata, approved artifacts, source references and checksum audit manifests; excludes secrets/internal prompts. Deletion enforces legal holds, tombstones, permitted blob/index removal and receipts. Held protected records remain **retained and receipted**; `202` is not completion. Tenant/workspace scope and partial completion remain open.

context_en: 6. Exception Handling Specification > Handling by Exception > ERR-024–027 — Exit, integrity, release and resilience
raw_text_en: 3. Closure snapshots approved answer/cited versions/review decisions and preserves immutable lineage. Case retention only for eligible closed cases; CLOSED alone insufficient and explicit reopen-as-new-revision remains possible. Purge/reopen races and legally permitted lineage purge require decision.

context_en: 6. Exception Handling Specification > Handling by Exception > ERR-024–027 — Exit, integrity, release and resilience
raw_text_en: 4. Audit/history/decisions remain append-only or immutable as declared. Operators may query, never edit historical review decisions. Vault/credential/encryption rotation obligations remain during recovery; exact rotation-failure response is open.

context_en: 6. Exception Handling Specification > Handling by Exception > ERR-024–027 — Exit, integrity, release and resilience
raw_text_en: 5. Every storage predicate includes tenant; pool scoped variables reset after **every transaction including failed ones**. Production additionally enforces workspace-tenancy membership by FK **OR** controlled writes. Missing context/reset failure and SQL-to-business errors remain open.

context_en: 6. Exception Handling Specification > Handling by Exception > ERR-024–027 — Exit, integrity, release and resilience
raw_text_en: 6. Compatible migration/canary/drain and signed build/config/evidence prerequisites apply. Unverified allowed-build digest cannot deploy. Regression triggers **automated traffic rollback, not DB down-migration**; general binary-first compensation only explicitly supported. Plans disclose whether new writes remain readable, not guarantee readability.

context_en: 6. Exception Handling Specification > Handling by Exception > ERR-024–027 — Exit, integrity, release and resilience
raw_text_en: 7. Low statistical confidence blocks release; independent prompt/model changes require reevaluation. Critical isolation/approval tests have zero exceptions; unmitigated critical cross-tenant OR approval bypass blocks regardless benchmark. SEC-001–012 evidence independently reviewed/reproduced and release-signed.

context_en: 6. Exception Handling Specification > Handling by Exception > ERR-024–027 — Exit, integrity, release and resilience
raw_text_en: 8. Primary writes/one warm region; snapshot restoration only under incident command. Reference **RPO≤15 min, RTO≤4 h**, continuous PostgreSQL backups and joint object/index-recipe checks. Lost heartbeats/object failures/primary outage need executable recovery contracts; objectives are not schedules.

raw_text_en: ### FLOW-001 — Shared entry, transaction and disclosure guards

context_en: 7. Processing Flow Specification > Normal Processing > FLOW-001 — Shared entry, transaction and disclosure guards
7. Processing Flow Specification > Normal Processing > FLOW-001 — Shared entry, transaction and disclosure guards
raw_text_en: 1. **FLOW-001.1:** Authenticate interactive sessions with authorization-code PKCE. Check issuer, audience, expiry, subject and tenant; reject unexpected algorithms/missing tenancy. Do not store long-lived refresh tokens in local storage. Secure `HttpOnly`, `SameSite` BFF cookies remain optional/unselected. Session routes/durations/refresh recovery are open. [Current PDF p.21 §5.1; `processing_flows:r1:c30:f1`, `processing_flows:r1:c30:f5`]

context_en: 7. Processing Flow Specification > Normal Processing > FLOW-001 — Shared entry, transaction and disclosure guards
raw_text_en: 2. **FLOW-001.2:** Bind principal/tenant and evaluate role, workspace membership, sensitivity, source ACL, action and separation of duties. Baseline roles: Analyst, Reviewer, Admin, Auditor, Service. Navigation is not authorization. Edge checks, in-transaction attribute reevaluation, retrieval checks, dispatch and publication guards apply independently. [pp.21–23; `processing_flows:r1:c29:f1`, `processing_flows:r1:c31:f1`, `processing_flows:r1:c31:f2`]

context_en: 7. Processing Flow Specification > Normal Processing > FLOW-001 — Shared entry, transaction and disclosure guards
raw_text_en: 3. **FLOW-001.3:** Validate before transaction, at domain invariants, before tool dispatch and before long-work allocation. Use tenant storage predicates/RLS. Reset pooled scoped variables after **every transaction**, including failed transactions by the universal wording. Additionally enforce workspace-tenancy membership by foreign keys **OR controlled write procedures**, unselected. [pp.51,56,86; `processing_flows:r1:c83:f2`, `processing_flows:r1:c92:f4`, `processing_flows:r1:c138:f23`, `processing_flows:r1:c138:f24`, `processing_flows:r1:c138:f25`]

context_en: 7. Processing Flow Specification > Normal Processing > FLOW-001 — Shared entry, transaction and disclosure guards
raw_text_en: 4. **FLOW-001.4:** Actual background jobs carry immutable tenant identity in signed envelopes. This neither freezes permissions nor makes the whole job immutable. General boundary tenant/actor context applies everywhere; fuller `tenant_id`, `revision`, `actor_id`, `occurred_at`, correlation ID records apply **wherever durable state changes**. Request `trace_id`/`correlation_id`, provider trace, canonical events, job signatures and SSE offsets are not declared aliases. [pp.22,48,64; `processing_flows:r1:c32:f2`, `processing_flows:r1:c78:f1`, `processing_flows:r1:c78:f2`, `processing_flows:r1:c108:f1`]

context_en: 7. Processing Flow Specification > Normal Processing > FLOW-001 — Shared entry, transaction and disclosure guards
raw_text_en: 5. **FLOW-001.5:** Reject stale/unauthorized business writes before their relevant named-event publication, leaving business state unchanged. One audit record applies to each accepted transition; retain separate denial/duplicate evidence. Public responses/errors exclude credentials, full prompts, retrieved documents and private existence; diagnostics exclude documents/API secrets/source text. [pp.49–50,64,84; `processing_flows:r1:c79:f9`, `processing_flows:r1:c82:f1`, `processing_flows:r1:c82:f3`, `processing_flows:r1:c107:f2`, `processing_flows:r1:c137:f22`]

context_en: 7. Processing Flow Specification > Normal Processing > FLOW-001 — Shared entry, transaction and disclosure guards
7. Processing Flow Specification > Normal Processing > FLOW-001 — Shared entry, transaction and disclosure guards
raw_text_en: Runtime prerequisites: private datastores/declared egress, distinct scoped identities, independently authorized internal HTTP/gRPC, external model gateway and no direct orchestrator DB credentials. Managed identity replaces static credentials where supported. [pp.9,18–19; `processing_flows:r1:c8:f1`, `processing_flows:r1:c24:f1`, `processing_flows:r1:c24:f5`, `processing_flows:r1:c25:f2`]

context_en: 7. Processing Flow Specification > Normal Processing > FLOW-002 — Case initiation and revision-controlled work
7. Processing Flow Specification > Normal Processing > FLOW-002 — Case initiation and revision-controlled work
raw_text_en: 1. **FLOW-002.1:** Authorized Analyst initiates case creation through the still-unmapped SCR-001/SCR-002 creation interaction: `POST /v1/cases` (`API-003`). Validate and apply idempotency; reference result `201`, case identifier, initial `NEW`. Intake includes attachments/business context; exact fields/completeness are open. [Current PDF pp.12,83; `processing_flows:r1:c13:f1`, `processing_flows:r1:c137:f6`]

context_en: 7. Processing Flow Specification > Normal Processing > FLOW-002 — Case initiation and revision-controlled work
raw_text_en: 2. **FLOW-002.2:** Case Service's `CaseCreated` carries case ID/revision concepts; consumer runs classifier (`BAT-001`). Asynchronous classification attaches labels, confidences and provenance. User corrections require a reason code, with correction endpoint/catalog/authorization open. Do not infer that run creation emits CaseCreated. [pp.12,87; `processing_flows:r1:c13:f1`, `processing_flows:r1:c139:f1`]

context_en: 7. Processing Flow Specification > Normal Processing > FLOW-002 — Case initiation and revision-controlled work
raw_text_en: 3. **FLOW-002.3:** Authorized Analyst/Reviewer reads current revision with `GET /v1/cases/{caseId}` (`API-004`, `200`). Owner-scoped mapping-open PATCH (`API-005`, `200/409`) submits `If-Match`. Read/mutate `cases`; preserve append-only `case_revisions`. Exact wire fields and revision-increment algorithm remain open. [pp.25,83,85; `processing_flows:r1:c37:f5`, `processing_flows:r1:c137:f7`, `processing_flows:r1:c137:f8`, `processing_flows:r1:c138:f4`, `processing_flows:r1:c138:f5`]

context_en: 7. Processing Flow Specification > Normal Processing > FLOW-002 — Case initiation and revision-controlled work
raw_text_en: 4. **FLOW-002.4:** Apply `BR-004/005`: `NEW→TRIAGED→IN_PROGRESS`; `IN_PROGRESS→PENDING_APPROVAL or RESOLVED`; `PENDING_APPROVAL→RESOLVED or IN_PROGRESS`, under role/revision/approval guards. Branch predicates are open. Priority derives from explicit impact/urgency, never model alone. Workspace business calendars set deadlines; advisory breach prediction cannot alter them. [pp.25,82; `processing_flows:r1:c37:f1`, `processing_flows:r1:c38:f1`, `processing_flows:r1:c38:f2`, `processing_flows:r1:c137:f2`]

context_en: 7. Processing Flow Specification > Normal Processing > FLOW-002 — Case initiation and revision-controlled work
7. Processing Flow Specification > Normal Processing > FLOW-002 — Case initiation and revision-controlled work
raw_text_en: **Transaction boundary:** preserve source wording: “Case mutations, approval decisions and outbox inserts commit in one ACID transaction.” It establishes the applicable local boundary, not that every case mutation creates an approval or that all services share a transaction. Indexing/webhooks are asynchronous reconciled. Exact participants per operation remain open. [p.52 §14.2.1; `processing_flows:r1:c85:f1`]

context_en: 7. Processing Flow Specification > Normal Processing > FLOW-003 — Provisioning, historic intake and connector sync
7. Processing Flow Specification > Normal Processing > FLOW-003 — Provisioning, historic intake and connector sync
raw_text_en: 1. **FLOW-003.1:** One idempotent provisioning workflow creates workspace policy, encryption references, role bindings, quotas and connector stubs (`BAT-012`). Visible incomplete provisioning blocks sync. Initiator/API/internal step order/completion predicate remain open; one workflow is not one transaction. [Current PDF p.78; `processing_flows:r1:c132:f1`, `processing_flows:r1:c132:f2`]

context_en: 7. Processing Flow Specification > Normal Processing > FLOW-003 — Provisioning, historic intake and connector sync
raw_text_en: 2. **FLOW-003.2:** Admin initiates `POST /v1/connectors/{connectorId}/sync` (`API-011`, `202`). Inspect advertised list/fetch/delta cursor/ACL/delete support and resolve workspace secret references. Capability gaps produce lower-trust visible warning, never permission bypass. [pp.27,83; `processing_flows:r1:c42:f1`, `processing_flows:r1:c42:f6`, `processing_flows:r1:c137:f14`]

context_en: 7. Processing Flow Specification > Normal Processing > FLOW-003 — Provisioning, historic intake and connector sync
raw_text_en: 3. **FLOW-003.3:** Workers fetch configured sources while preserving identity, ACL and history; route allowed source intake into FLOW-004. Persist provider cursor/high-watermark/error ledger (`connector_cursors`). Advance only when **all preceding items have durable ingestion outcomes**. Item/batch transaction units and exact source-to-ingestion message contracts remain open. [pp.27–28,85; `processing_flows:r1:c41:f1`, `processing_flows:r1:c43:f1`, `processing_flows:r1:c138:f16`]

context_en: 7. Processing Flow Specification > Normal Processing > FLOW-003 — Provisioning, historic intake and connector sync
raw_text_en: 4. **FLOW-003.4:** Historic backfill uses bounded windows/stable source IDs/per-batch reconciliation receipts (`BAT-003`). Search readiness derives from index coverage, not queue emptiness. Window bounds/coverage formula/threshold and whole-job completion are open. [p.78; `processing_flows:r1:c132:f7`, `processing_flows:r1:c132:f8`]

context_en: 7. Processing Flow Specification > Normal Processing > FLOW-003 — Provisioning, historic intake and connector sync
raw_text_en: 5. **FLOW-003.5:** Source deletes tombstone and schedule index removal; ACL changes invalidate affected caches before new results. Revocation applies before next retrieval despite pending index cleanup. Sync history interface `GET /v1/connectors/{connectorId}/runs` exists; complete status/readback linkage is open. [pp.27–29; `processing_flows:r1:c41:f2`, `processing_flows:r1:c43:f5`, `processing_flows:r1:c43:f6`, `processing_flows:r1:c45:f7`]

context_en: 7. Processing Flow Specification > Normal Processing > FLOW-004 — Attachment, normalization and index production

raw_text_en: 1. **FLOW-004.1:** Analyst submits `POST /v1/cases/{caseId}/attachments` (`API-006`, `202` ingestion operation). Admit PDF, DOCX, HTML, UTF-8 text, signature-extension agreement, configurable **25 MB/file**, bomb protection. `202` is not READY. [Current PDF pp.30,83; `processing_flows:r1:c48:f1`, `processing_flows:r1:c137:f9`]

context_en: 7. Processing Flow Specification > Normal Processing > FLOW-004 — Attachment, normalization and index production
